title: Set governance depth from system context
description: Choose a use case, then change autonomy and reach. Observe how internal review depth and evidence expectations should grow. This is triage, not legal classification.

bands.label: Limited review
bands.summary: Keep inventory, baseline evaluation, owner, user notice, and a clear escalation path.

bands.label: Enhanced review
bands.summary: Add impact mapping, critical-slice evaluation, human oversight testing, and bounded rollout.

bands.label: Stringent review
bands.summary: Require independent challenge, strict release evidence, rehearsed fallback, incident readiness, and time-bounded approval.
